measurement_notes: Baseline is HTTP request-to-complete-WAV time for one 61-character clip; the original player waited for that WAV before audio.
Updated first audio was observed through native Chrome WebAudio after Play. Browser-control round trips make these first-audio figures upper bounds.
Both runs used the same resident XTTS process, model and reference. Companion cache was empty after the reversible update installation.
These are single synthetic readings, not statistical benchmarks or universal latency guarantees.
A next-clip request occurred after the current AudioBufferSource connected and before it disconnected, proving overlapped synthesis.
Uncached XTTS inference remains slower than playback; gaps can remain. An already-started inference can finish after Stop.
